summary: AXIA Energia S.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the settlement of its 11th issuance of simple, non-convertible, unsecured debentures in a single series for BRL 500 million. The offering was conducted under automatic registration for professional investors, with tax incentives under Law 12,431/2011. The debentures pay IPCA + 7.9537% p.a., mature July 15, 2036, with semiannual interest and annual amortization starting in year 8. This is a routine debt financing transaction, not a special situation.
